We strive to provide an inclusive and user-friendly experience by complying with the Israeli Standard (IS 5568) – Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at the AA level. ​ Website Accessibility Features To enhance accessibility, we have implemented the following features: Keyboard navigation – Our website is fully navigable using a keyboard. Screen reader compatibility – The site is structured to be compatible with screen readers. Color contrast – Sufficient contrast is maintained between text and background for readability. Alternative text – Images and multimedia elements include descriptive alternative text where applicable. Resizable text – Users can adjust text size for better readability. Forms and links – Labels and descriptions are provided to improve usability for assistive technologies. ​ Use of Accessibility Plugins Our website does not rely on third-party accessibility overlays but is designed to be accessible by default. If any additional tools or plugins are used, they will be noted here. ​ Feedback and Reporting Accessibility Issues We are continually working to improve the accessibility of our website. If you encounter any accessibility barriers or have suggestions, please let us know at [email protected] , and we will make every effort to address the issue. ​ Last updated: March 18, 2025 ©2024 Citrusˣ.
